//: Playwright transpiles the specs with esbuild and never type-checks them, so
this file only ever serves an editor or a hand-run tsc.
DOM is in lib because a spec is two languages in one file: the outer half is
Node, and everything inside page.evaluate() is browser code. window, URL,
setTimeout and import.meta.url all come from here.
The Node half is still unresolved: 'node' cannot go in types until
@types/node is a devDependency of this package, and typescript is not one
either, so a standalone `tsc -p e2e` still reports process, Buffer and the
node: imports. Adding both is a dependency decision, not a config one.
